The brief

A natural health store with two Ontario locations and an online shop that ships across Canada. The goal was a website that loads fast, explains every service clearly and turns local searches into calls and bookings.

What I did

  • Website development and ongoing updates on Shopify.
  • Keyword research and on-page SEO for the main service pages: titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links.
  • Technical SEO: indexing checks, site speed and structured data (schema markup).
  • Local SEO: location-focused content and local citations for Pickering & Scarborough, Ontario.

Highlights

  • Shopify store with Canada-wide shipping
  • Product collections organized by health need
  • BreadcrumbList schema on the live site
